extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance figures digitised: Figure 7 (CO2 conversion, methanol selectivity and CO selectivity versus temperature) and Figure 8 (methanol selectivity versus CO2 conversion at 280 °C and 220 °C). Characterisation figures, DRIFTS spectra and literature-comparison Table 2 were not digitised. Figure 8 does not state in the caption or surrounding text how CO2 conversion was varied; the general reaction conditions from Experimental section 2.3 are therefore reported, with this caveat in the record notes. Values read from markers are approximate and marked with qualifier '~'.
